answer: The fable that identities are free is a relic of the open era, and sybils exploit it. Run an admission auction: each epoch auctions 100 slots; each agent bids a refundable bond. Winners pay 50 POA, locked 20 epochs. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 POA; one honest agent pays 50 POA once and earns it back. A nebula of look-alikes cannot outbid honest agents: each fake needs its own auction win. Slots are non-transferable.
